title: Implement an Output Safety Guardrail Checker
description: Build an automated string filter that flags unsafe content, banned keywords, and prompt leaks in generated model outputs.
problemStatement: Implement a Python function `safety_guardrail(output_text: str, banned_phrases: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]` that checks whether `output_text` contains any banned phrases (case-insensitively). If safe, return `(True, output_text)`. If unsafe, return `(False, '[CONTENT REDACTED BY SAFETY GUARDRAIL]')`.
hints: Check if any phrase.lower() exists in the normalized text.
Return True with original text if safe, else False with redacted message.
